description: Completion of constructions of Health Care Institutions where constructions have been currently suspended
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the COVID-19 pandemic and the subsequent economic crisis, steps have been taken to suspend a number of construction projects being carried out in healthcare institutions as per the recommendation of the then Re-Strategizing and Accelerating Large, and Mage-Scale Projects (RAMP) Committee. Considering the existing healthcare infrastructure and the increasing demand for healthcare services, the need to complete the said projects which remain in various stages of construction has been identified by now. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to resume the construction works of the following 08 healthcare infrastructure projects, which have not yet been completed, by revising the total cost estimates and time frames thereof, was approved by the Cabinet: ProjectRevised Total Cost Estimate(Rs.
